query:
SELECT
                    EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM hr_employee_assignments
                        WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND employee_id = $2 AND date_start > $3
                    )
                    OR EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM hr_employee_schedule_assignments
                        WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND employee_id = $2 AND date_start > $3
                    ) AS "exists!"
